sourceLocks.claim: Candidate panel uses graphic 40 and transparent palette index 6; PC34 route blits it into C101_ZONE_PANEL.
Resurrect/reincarnate panel graphic identity is the numbered C040 asset, not filename-only evidence.
Transparent color is palette index 6 (dark green).
The PC34 panel target is zone C101.
The old PC panel bitmap box is viewport-relative x=80..223 y=52..124; when lifted to full screen this is x=80..223 y=85..157 because viewport y origin is 33.
Any candidate inventory redraw must show the Hall decision panel.
Candidate mode redraws inventory/panel but suppresses save/rest/close affordances.
Portrait click appends a temporary candidate champion and updates leader/action UI according to party count.
Cancel closes inventory, clears candidate ordinal, removes the candidate status/HUD slot, and redraws menus.
Resurrect/reincarnate confirmation clears candidate mode, unlinks possessions, disables the mirror sensor, and branches to reincarnation rename.
Panel choice commands dispatch only from the decision panel and only while the leader hand is empty.
The Hall decision set is exactly resurrect/reincarnate/cancel.
Status box/inventory toggles and inventory close are blocked while the candidate panel is active.
Rest/wake/save menu paths cannot escape the Hall candidate modal.

deltaBuckets.highestImpactFinding: HUD/status crop deltas for cancel/resurrect/reincarnate are dominated by compared visual-state buckets: Firestaff/original inputs alternate between all-black, Firestaff gray status HUD, and original brown Hall top band. This is a capture/semantic-stop alignment blocker before renderer pixel parity can be interpreted.

semanticStopAlignment.finding: For cancel/resurrect/reincarnate HUD/status crops, the original corrected captures are consistent with terminal Hall source stops; Firestaff is captured after synthetic M11 status messages or an all-black status stop, so these HUD/status rows cannot be used for renderer parity yet.

firestaffRouteBlocker.finding: The available Firestaff pass449 export drives the corridor-facing front-mirror helper path, while the corrected original terminal captures are keyed to the initial-Hall C080 portrait/candidate click route. Re-running the exporter against the currently modeled front-mirror helper only reproduces the same all-black/gray HUD buckets, so replacing these rows needs an M11 C080 initial-Hall candidate click/source-stop capture path rather than another crop copy.
